mechanism_of_action: An ionic salt of berberine and ursodeoxycholic acid.
primary_endpoint: Reduction in liver fat content measured by MRI-PDFF at 18 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: At 1000 mg twice daily, mean absolute liver-fat decrease was 4.8% versus 2.0% with placebo (p=0.011).
safety_signal: Diarrhea and abdominal discomfort were the most frequently reported adverse events.
